rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root, not a candidate: the classical D^2-law with the published median rate, replaced by the prefix's own finite-difference rate as the prefix grows; no extinction and no evaporation. Same numbers as the baseline of flex_methanol-wsp-v3, with the tensors added by flex_methanol-wsp-v4 (art.*, post.he_w, post.seen_max) set to their neutral values. Data-informed candidates of flex_methanol-wsp-v4 are literal revisions of this release.
